name: meshmind-motion
description: MeshMind motion graphics, made with Remotion. Separate from the app: it has its own dependencies.

scripts.render: remotion render MeshMind out/meshmind.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=16 && remotion render MeshMind out/meshmind.wav --codec=wav && node tools/py.mjs tools/master.py out/meshmind.mp4 out/meshmind.wav out/MeshMind-motion.mp4
